name: Pantanal Conservation Area
description: This cluster of four protected areas in the southwest corner of Mato Grosso, western Brazil, covers about 188,000 hectares of the Pantanal, one of the planet's largest freshwater wetlands. It is where the Cuiabá and Paraguay river systems begin. In the rainy season much of the surrounding floodplain goes under water, drawing a dense and spectacular mix of plants and wildlife.
